cue.en: Set your feet roughly shoulder-width apart before you raise the pistol.

rationale.en: A repeatable base width makes the hold reproducible.

cue.en: Keep your torso tall; check your lean against your usual setup.

rationale.en: Unintended lateral lean changes the hold geometry.

cue.en: Lock your shooting arm a little straighter.

rationale.en: A consistent elbow angle reduces hold variability.

cue.en: Level your shoulders before settling into the hold.

rationale.en: Shoulder tilt is a common source of drift.

cue.en: Settle your breathing and let the wrist quiet down before aiming.

rationale.en: Wrist motion in setup carries into the hold.
Requires pistol tracking; shown only when hardware evidence exists.

cue.en: Your hold moved more than usual. Reset and rebuild the position.

rationale.en: Posture stability is a proxy, not a shot score.

cue.en: The pistol hand drifted sideways during the hold.

rationale.en: Drift indicates fatigue or an unbalanced stance.

AMBIGUOUS_SUBJECT.en: Another person is in the frame. Only the shooter should be visible.

FRAMING_INVALID.en: Move the camera back so your whole body and feet are visible.

MISSING_JOINT.en: Some joints are hidden. Keep your full body in view of the camera.

LOW_CONFIDENCE.en: Tracking is unsteady. Improve lighting and reduce clutter behind you.

VIEW_INVALID.en: This check needs a different camera angle; it is paused for now.

TIME_GAP.en: Tracking paused. Checks restart when tracking resumes.

TRACK_CHANGED.en: Lost track of you briefly. Checks restart now.

HANDEDNESS_UNKNOWN.en: Set your shooting hand in the session setup to enable arm checks.

CAPABILITY_MISSING.en: Pistol tracking hardware is not connected, so sight checks are off.

SAFETY.en: Keep the camera and anyone operating it behind the firing line.
